name: Diana, Moonpiercer negate mode: the attacker declines to pay (2) and the combat phase ends
notes: Diana, Moonpiercer (RANGER) defends a Dungeon Guide attack; player 1 answers with Ranger Boots (Diana becomes distant) and picks the negate mode. Because Diana is defending, the attacking player is asked to pay (2); declining ends the combat phase, so the Dungeon Guide rests but Diana takes no damage.

rulesClauses: Negate each card activation that targets Diana unless its controller pays (2). Then if Diana is defending, end the combat phase unless the attacking player pays (2).
